description: This header file defines the ControlBackend class, which implements the ControlBackendInterface for managing application state and control client registration within the Rialto client namespace. It includes class definitions, member functions, and internal logic for handling application state changes and synchronization.

classes.name: ControlBackend
classes.description: Final class implementing ControlBackendInterface, managing control client registration, application state monitoring, and synchronization.

classes.name: ControlClient
classes.description: Nested class implementing IControlClient, responsible for receiving application state change notifications and forwarding them to ControlBackend.

methods.name: ControlBackend
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control backend, creating control client, and registering it.

methods.name: ~ControlBackend
methods.description: Destructor resetting the control control pointer.

methods.name: removeControlBackend
methods.description: Method to reset the control control pointer, effectively removing the backend.

methods.name: waitForRunning
methods.description: Waits for the application state to become RUNNING, with a timeout of 1 second.

methods.name: onApplicationStateChanged
methods.description: Handles application state change notifications, updates internal state, and notifies waiting threads.
